quote: Briefly, gibel carp were intraperitoneally injected with 200 μL of virus suspension respectively.

text_en: In short, silver crucian carp were each given an intraperitoneal injection of 200 microliters of virus suspension.

statement: 鲫鱼使用3-氨基苯甲酸乙酯甲磺酸盐（MS222）进行麻醉。

text_en: Crucian carp were anesthetized using ethyl 3-aminobenzoate methanesulfonate (MS222).

quote: Blood samples were collected from the caudal vein and were placed for 1 h at room temperature.
statement: 从尾静脉采集血液样本并在室温下放置1小时。
text_zh: 从尾静脉采集血液样本并在室温下放置1小时。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the caudal vein and left at room temperature for 1 hour.

text_en: A kihelyezett pontyok egyedsűrűsége 44000 db/hektár volt, ami megfelel a gyakorlati irányszámoknak.

statement: A halak az első két héten előnevelő takarmányt, később pedig búza- és kukoricadarát kaptak reggelente.
text_en: A halak az első két héten előnevelő takarmányt, később pedig búza- és kukoricadarát kaptak reggelente.

statement: A lehalászás során 6-os szemméretű, 25 méter hosszú és 2,5 méter mély húzóhálót használtak.
text_en: A lehalászás során 6-os szemméretű, 25 méter hosszú és 2,5 méter mély húzóhálót használtak.

A

quote: no more fish died after 7 dpi in all groups (Figure 5 B).
statement: 在攻毒后第7天（dpi）之后，所有实验组均不再有鱼死亡。
text_zh: 在攻毒后第7天（dpi）之后，所有实验组均不再有鱼死亡。
text_en: After 7 days post-infection (dpi), no fish died in any of the experimental groups.

quote: A band of about 324 bp was amplified in each fish (Figure 5 C). The fragment was sequenced and CyHV-2 in these fish was confirmed.
statement: 对濒死鱼进行RT-PCR检测，扩增出约324bp的条带并测序确认存在CyHV-2病毒。
text_zh: 对濒死鱼进行RT-PCR检测，扩增出约324bp的条带并测序确认存在CyHV-2病毒。
text_en: RT-PCR testing of moribund fish amplified a band of about 324 bp, and sequencing confirmed the presence of CyHV-2 virus.

quote: Both pcORF25 and inactivated vaccine could increase the levels of serum IgM, and the levels of serum IgM were higher when combined with adjuvant.
statement: pcORF25和灭活疫苗均能提高血清IgM水平，且与佐剂联合使用时血清IgM水平更高。
text_zh: pcORF25和灭活疫苗均能提高血清IgM水平，且与佐剂联合使用时血清IgM水平更高。
text_en: Both pcORF25 and the inactivated vaccine can increase serum IgM levels, and serum IgM levels are higher when used in combination with an adjuvant.

quote: Dead fish were collected, and spleens were sampled for CyHV-2 detection by RT-PCR.
statement: 收集死亡鱼类并取样脾脏，通过RT-PCR检测CyHV-2。
text_zh: 收集死亡鱼类并取样脾脏，通过RT-PCR检测CyHV-2。
text_en: Dead fish were collected and spleen samples were taken for CyHV-2 detection by RT-PCR.

quote: The serum biochemical indexes of complement 3 (C3), lysozyme and total superoxide dismutase (TSOD) were assayed by the corresponding commercial kits
statement: 使用相应的商业试剂盒测定补体3（C3）、溶菌酶和总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）等血清生化指标。

text_en: Serum biochemical indicators such as complement 3 (C3), lysozyme, and total superoxide dismutase (TSOD) were measured using corresponding commercial kits.

quote: pcORF25/pcCCL35.2 Treatment Effectively Relieves the Tissue Lesions against Virus Infection
statement: pcORF25/pcCCL35.2 treatment effectively relieves tissue lesions caused by virus infection.
text_en: pcORF25/pcCCL35.2 treatment effectively relieves tissue lesions caused by virus infection.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: Vaccine, CCL35.2, pcDNA3.1-neo and PBS groups showed the most severe lesions including vacuolization, karyorrhexis, hypertrophied nuclei and sloughing of the epithelial cells.
statement: The Vaccine, CCL35.2, pcDNA3.1-neo, and PBS groups exhibited the most severe tissue lesions, including vacuolization, karyorrhexis, hypertrophied nuclei, and epithelial cell sloughing.
text_en: The Vaccine, CCL35.2, pcDNA3.1-neo, and PBS groups exhibited the most severe tissue lesions, including vacuolization, karyorrhexis, hypertrophied nuclei, and epithelial cell sloughing.

quote: By contrast with the healthy tissue, CCL35.2/ORF25 group had evidently protective effect, ORF25 and CCL35.2/Vaccine group had some protective effect.
statement: Compared to healthy tissue, the CCL35.2/ORF25 group showed an evident protective effect, while the ORF25 and CCL35.2/Vaccine groups showed some protective effect.
text_en: Compared to healthy tissue, the CCL35.2/ORF25 group showed an evident protective effect, while the ORF25 and CCL35.2/Vaccine groups showed some protective effect.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: These results suggested that pcCCL35.2/pcORF25 treatment can effectively protect fish tissues from lesions.
statement: The results suggest that pcCCL35.2/pcORF25 treatment can effectively protect fish tissues from lesions.
text_en: The results suggest that pcCCL35.2/pcORF25 treatment can effectively protect fish tissues from lesions.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: CyHV-2 (50 μL, 1 × 10 7 TCID 50 mL −1) challenge was intraperitoneally carried out on 14-day post injection (dpi).
statement: 在注射后第14天进行腹腔注射攻毒，剂量为50微升（1×10^7 TCID50/mL）的CyHV-2病毒。
text_zh: 在注射后第14天进行腹腔注射攻毒，剂量为50微升（1×10^7 TCID50/mL）的CyHV-2病毒。
text_en: On day 14 post-injection, intraperitoneal challenge was performed with CyHV-2 virus at a dose of 50 microliters (1×10^7 TCID50/mL).

quote: Five fish of each group were sacrificed for harvesting serum, spleen and head kidney tissues on 1, 3, 7, 14, 15, 17, 21, and 28 dpi for serum biochemistry and qRT-PCR, and spleen, trunk kidney, gill tissues were collected from each group on 21 dpi for histopathological examination.
statement: 在各组特定时间点处死鱼以采集血清、脾脏、头肾等组织用于生化分析和qRT-PCR，并在21 dpi采集组织用于病理检查。
text_zh: 在各组特定时间点处死鱼以采集血清、脾脏、头肾等组织用于生化分析和qRT-PCR，并在21 dpi采集组织用于病理检查。
text_en: Fish were euthanized at specific time points in each group to collect serum, spleen, head kidney and other tissues for biochemical analysis and qRT-PCR, and tissues were collected at 21 dpi for pathological examination.

quote: The mortality was monitored from 14 to 28 dpi.
statement: 从攻毒后第14天到第28天监测死亡率。
text_zh: 从攻毒后第14天到第28天监测死亡率。
text_en: Mortality was monitored from day 14 to day 28 post-challenge.

quote: The serum antibody titer in grass carp was determined by the enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA).
statement: 通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）确定草鱼的血清抗体滴度。
text_zh: 通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）确定草鱼的血清抗体滴度。
text_en: Serum antibody titers of grass carp were determined by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA).

quote: In the Vaccine, CCL35.2, pcDNA3.1-neo and PBS groups, gibel carp began to die on 3 dpi.
statement: 在疫苗、CCL35.2、pcDNA3.1-neo和PBS组中，鲫鱼在攻毒后第3天开始死亡。
text_zh: 在疫苗、CCL35.2、pcDNA3.1-neo和PBS组中，鲫鱼在攻毒后第3天开始死亡。
text_en: In the vaccine, CCL35.2, pcDNA3.1-neo, and PBS groups, crucian carp began to die on day 3 post-challenge.

quote: In the ORF25 and CCL35.2 + Vaccine groups, fish death occurred on 4 dpi.
statement: 在ORF25组和CCL35.2加疫苗组中，鱼在第4天出现死亡。
text_zh: 在ORF25组和CCL35.2加疫苗组中，鱼在第4天出现死亡。
text_en: In the ORF25 group and the CCL35.2 plus vaccine group, fish died on day 4.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: Meanwhile, death occurrence was delayed on 5 dpi in the CCL35.2/ORF25 group (Figure 5 B and Table 1).
statement: 同时，在CCL35.2/ORF25组中，死亡发生延迟至第5天。
text_zh: 同时，在CCL35.2/ORF25组中，死亡发生延迟至第5天。
text_en: At the same time, in the CCL35.2/ORF25 group, mortality was delayed until day 5.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: The protection rates of Vaccine, CCL35.2, and PBS groups were 0% as the same as that of the control group.
statement: 疫苗、CCL35.2和PBS组的保护率为0%，与对照组相同。
text_zh: 疫苗、CCL35.2和PBS组的保护率为0%，与对照组相同。
text_en: The protection rate in the vaccine, CCL35.2, and PBS groups was 0%, the same as in the control group.

quote: The protection rate of CCL35.2/ORF25 group was the highest among all the experimental groups, reaching 50%.
statement: CCL35.2/ORF25组的保护率在所有实验组中最高，达到50%。
text_zh: CCL35.2/ORF25组的保护率在所有实验组中最高，达到50%。
text_en: The protection rate of the CCL35.2/ORF25 group was the highest among all experimental groups, reaching 50%.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: DNA vaccine (CyHV-2 ORF25) conjugated with molecular adjuvant CCL35.2 (mammalian CCL4 analogue) remarkably improved the survival rate of gibel carp against CyHV-2 infection (a fulminating infectious disease).
statement: 将分子佐剂CCL35.2与DNA疫苗（CyHV-2 ORF25）结合使用，显著提高了银鲫对CyHV-2感染的存活率。
text_zh: 将分子佐剂CCL35.2与DNA疫苗（CyHV-2 ORF25）结合使用，显著提高了银鲫对CyHV-2感染的存活率。
text_en: Combining the molecular adjuvant CCL35.2 with a DNA vaccine (CyHV-2 ORF25) significantly improved the survival rate of gibel carp against CyHV-2 infection.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: This strategy can effectively promote the specific antibody levels, titers, and virus neutralization capacity in important immune tissues and serum, serum innate immune indices, and mRNA expressions of immune regulation and effector genes, relieve the main target tissue lesions, and suppress the virus replication.
statement: 该策略能有效促进免疫组织和血清中的特异性抗体水平、滴度和病毒中和能力，提高血清先天免疫指标及免疫调节和效应基因的mRNA表达，缓解主要靶组织病变并抑制病毒复制。
text_zh: 该策略能有效促进免疫组织和血清中的特异性抗体水平、滴度和病毒中和能力，提高血清先天免疫指标及免疫调节和效应基因的mRNA表达，缓解主要靶组织病变并抑制病毒复制。
text_en: This strategy effectively promotes specific antibody levels, titers, and virus neutralizing capacity in immune tissues and serum, improves serum innate immune indicators and mRNA expression of immunoregulatory and effector genes, alleviates lesions in major target tissues, and inhibits viral replication.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant
outcome: 免疫反应/组织病变/病毒复制

quote: Three treatments have significantly inhibitory effect on the replication of the virus in head kidney, including ORF25, CCL35.2/ORF25, and CCL35.2/Vaccine groups.
statement: 三种处理（ORF25、CCL35.2/ORF25和CCL35.2/Vaccine组）对头肾中的病毒复制具有显著抑制作用。
text_zh: 三种处理（ORF25、CCL35.2/ORF25和CCL35.2/Vaccine组）对头肾中的病毒复制具有显著抑制作用。
text_en: Three treatments (ORF25, CCL35.2/ORF25 and CCL35.2/Vaccine groups) had a significant inhibitory effect on viral replication in the head kidney.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: CCL35.2/ORF25 group was the most effective in inhibiting CyHV-2 (Figure 10 A).
statement: CCL35.2/ORF25组在抑制CyHV-2方面最有效。
text_zh: CCL35.2/ORF25组在抑制CyHV-2方面最有效。
text_en: The CCL35.2/ORF25 group was the most effective in inhibiting CyHV-2.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: The results indicated that molecular adjuvant/DNA vaccine can indeed inhibit the proliferation of CyHV-2.
statement: 结果表明，分子佐剂/DNA疫苗确实可以抑制CyHV-2的增殖。
text_zh: 结果表明，分子佐剂/DNA疫苗确实可以抑制CyHV-2的增殖。
text_en: The results showed that the molecular adjuvant/DNA vaccine indeed inhibited the proliferation of CyHV-2.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: Since gibel carp is an invasive fish species, all collected individuals were euthanized with clove oil before tissue samples were collected for DNA sequencing.
statement: 由于鲫鱼是入侵物种，所有采集的个体在收集组织样本进行DNA测序前均使用丁香油安乐死。
text_zh: 由于鲫鱼是入侵物种，所有采集的个体在收集组织样本进行DNA测序前均使用丁香油安乐死。
text_en: Since crucian carp are an invasive species, all collected individuals were euthanized using clove oil before tissue samples were collected for DNA sequencing.

quote: In CCL35.2/ORF25 group, the lysozyme activity rose after vaccination, then decreased slightly, and increased even more after challenge.
statement: 在CCL35.2/ORF25组中，溶菌酶活性在接种疫苗后上升，随后略有下降，攻毒后进一步升高。
text_zh: 在CCL35.2/ORF25组中，溶菌酶活性在接种疫苗后上升，随后略有下降，攻毒后进一步升高。
text_en: In the CCL35.2/ORF25 group, lysozyme activity increased after vaccination, then decreased slightly, and further increased after challenge.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: The lysozyme activity of CCL35.2/ORF25 group increased more rapidly after challenge, and there was significant difference compared with other groups on 17 dpi (Figure 6 B).
statement: CCL35.2/ORF25组攻毒后的溶菌酶活性增加更快，且在接种后17天与其他组相比存在显著差异。
text_zh: CCL35.2/ORF25组攻毒后的溶菌酶活性增加更快，且在接种后17天与其他组相比存在显著差异。
text_en: Lysozyme activity increased faster after challenge in the CCL35.2/ORF25 group, and there was a significant difference compared with other groups at 17 days post-vaccination.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: The TSOD activity in CCL35.2/ORF25 group increased more rapidly (Figure 6 C).
statement: CCL35.2/ORF25组的TSOD活性增加得更快。
text_zh: CCL35.2/ORF25组的TSOD活性增加得更快。
text_en: TSOD activity increased faster in the CCL35.2/ORF25 group.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: Bizonyított tény az is, hogy adott körülmények között ugyanúgy, mint a ponty, akár ivadékfalásra is hajlamos (Kukuradze és Mariash, 1975).
statement: Adott körülmények között az ezüstkárász, akárcsak a ponty, hajlamos lehet az ivadékfalásra.
text_en: Adott körülmények között az ezüstkárász, akárcsak a ponty, hajlamos lehet az ivadékfalásra.

quote: pcORF25/pcCCL35.2 Mixture Remarkably Improves the Survival Rate of Gibel Carp
statement: pcORF25与pcCCL35.2的混合物显著提高了鲫鱼的存活率。
text_zh: pcORF25与pcCCL35.2的混合物显著提高了鲫鱼的存活率。
text_en: The mixture of pcORF25 and pcCCL35.2 significantly improved the survival rate of crucian carp.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: Then they were challenged with CyHV-2 on 14 dpi.
statement: 随后在接种后第14天用CyHV-2对鱼进行攻击感染。
text_zh: 随后在接种后第14天用CyHV-2对鱼进行攻击感染。
text_en: Fish were then challenged with CyHV-2 on day 14 post-inoculation.

quote: Fish survival was monitored and counted in the next 14 days (Figure 3).
statement: 在接下来的14天内监测并统计鱼的存活情况。
text_zh: 在接下来的14天内监测并统计鱼的存活情况。

quote: pcORF25/pcCCL35.2 group demonstrated highest survival rate (70%), which was significantly higher than other groups.
statement: pcORF25/pcCCL35.2组表现出最高的存活率（70%），显著高于其他组。
text_zh: pcORF25/pcCCL35.2组表现出最高的存活率（70%），显著高于其他组。
text_en: The pcORF25/pcCCL35.2 group showed the highest survival rate (70%), significantly higher than other groups.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: Compared with PBS group, DNA vaccine and inactivated vaccine could provide a certain protective effect to gibel carp, but DNA vaccine had higher protective effect.
statement: 与PBS组相比，DNA疫苗和灭活疫苗都能为鲫鱼提供一定的保护效果，但DNA疫苗的保护效果更高。
text_zh: 与PBS组相比，DNA疫苗和灭活疫苗都能为鲫鱼提供一定的保护效果，但DNA疫苗的保护效果更高。
text_en: Compared with the PBS group, both DNA vaccines and inactivated vaccines provided a certain level of protection to crucian carp, but the protective effect of the DNA vaccine was higher.

quote: DNA and inactivated vaccines conjugated with adjuvant showed better results.
statement: 与佐剂结合的DNA疫苗和灭活疫苗显示出更好的结果。
text_zh: 与佐剂结合的DNA疫苗和灭活疫苗显示出更好的结果。
text_en: DNA vaccines and inactivated vaccines combined with adjuvants showed better results.

quote: Viperin expression in the CCL35.2/ORF25 group remained at a high level, indicating that this method could enable gibel carp to establish a barrier against virus and effectively fight against CyHV-2 infection.
statement: CCL35.2/ORF25组中Viperin表达维持在高水平，表明该方法能使银鲫建立抗病毒屏障并有效抵抗CyHV-2感染。
text_zh: CCL35.2/ORF25组中Viperin表达维持在高水平，表明该方法能使银鲫建立抗病毒屏障并有效抵抗CyHV-2感染。
text_en: Viperin expression remained at a high level in the CCL35.2/ORF25 group, indicating that this method enables gibel carp to establish an antiviral barrier and effectively resist CyHV-2 infection.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

text_en: Compared with other groups, CyHV-2 replication in the head kidney and spleen tissues was more strongly inhibited in the ORF25/CCL35.2 group.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: Considering economic, environmental, and ethical factors, as well as protective effect, vaccination against disease is currently the most appropriate way for aquaculture to control pathogens
statement: 考虑到经济、环境和伦理因素以及保护效果，疫苗接种是目前水产养殖控制病原体的最合适方法。
text_zh: 考虑到经济、环境和伦理因素以及保护效果，疫苗接种是目前水产养殖控制病原体的最合适方法。
text_en: Considering economic, environmental and ethical factors as well as protective effects, vaccination is currently the most appropriate method for controlling pathogens in aquaculture.

quote: DNA vaccine, as the third generation vaccine, has clear advantages in the prevention and control of immunization in major diseases in aquaculture
statement: DNA疫苗作为第三代疫苗，在水产养殖主要疾病的免疫预防和控制方面具有明显优势。
text_zh: DNA疫苗作为第三代疫苗，在水产养殖主要疾病的免疫预防和控制方面具有明显优势。
text_en: As third-generation vaccines, DNA vaccines have clear advantages in the immunological prevention and control of major diseases in aquaculture.

quote: Herein, 36 ORFs encoding for the membrane proteins of CyHV-2 were analyzed by a bioinformatics technique, among which the ORF25 protein had the best immunogenicity, and a better protection rate was obtained when using DNA vaccine encoding ORF25
statement: 通过生物信息学技术分析编码CyHV-2膜蛋白的36个ORF，其中ORF25蛋白免疫原性最好，使用编码ORF25的DNA疫苗获得了更好的保护率。
text_zh: 通过生物信息学技术分析编码CyHV-2膜蛋白的36个ORF，其中ORF25蛋白免疫原性最好，使用编码ORF25的DNA疫苗获得了更好的保护率。
text_en: Bioinformatics analysis of the 36 ORFs encoding CyHV-2 membrane proteins showed that the ORF25 protein had the best immunogenicity, and a DNA vaccine encoding ORF25 achieved a better protection rate.

population.species: CyHV-2宿主（未明确，后文提及gibel carp）

quote: In another experiment, 20 μg truncated proteins of ORF25, ORF25C and ORF25D were used to immunize healthy gibel carp, after challenge, protection rates were 75%, 63%, 54% respectively
statement: 在另一项实验中，用20微克ORF25、ORF25C和ORF25D截短蛋白免疫健康银鲫，攻毒后保护率分别为75%、63%和54%。
text_zh: 在另一项实验中，用20微克ORF25、ORF25C和ORF25D截短蛋白免疫健康银鲫，攻毒后保护率分别为75%、63%和54%。
text_en: In another experiment, healthy gibel carp were immunized with 20 micrograms of ORF25, ORF25C and ORF25D truncated proteins; the protection rates after challenge were 75%, 63% and 54%, respectively.

quote: The result indicated that molecular adjuvant CCL35.2 combined with DNA vaccine ORF25 could remarkably promote humoral immunity to achieve the better protection effect of fish.
statement: 结果表明，分子佐剂CCL35.2与DNA疫苗ORF25结合可显著促进体液免疫，从而实现对鱼类的更好保护效果。
text_zh: 结果表明，分子佐剂CCL35.2与DNA疫苗ORF25结合可显著促进体液免疫，从而实现对鱼类的更好保护效果。
text_en: The results showed that combining the molecular adjuvant CCL35.2 with the DNA vaccine ORF25 significantly promoted humoral immunity, thereby achieving better protective effects in fish.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: The fish mortality was evidently relieved in the group injected virus incubated with pcCCL35.2/pcORF25 group serum, indicating that CCL35.2/ORF25 group serum had better neutralizing efficacy to CyHV-2.
statement: 注射了与pcCCL35.2/pcORF25组血清孵育的病毒的鱼群死亡率明显降低，表明CCL35.2/ORF25组血清对CyHV-2具有更好的中和效力。
text_zh: 注射了与pcCCL35.2/pcORF25组血清孵育的病毒的鱼群死亡率明显降低，表明CCL35.2/ORF25组血清对CyHV-2具有更好的中和效力。
text_en: The mortality rate of fish groups injected with virus incubated with serum from the pcCCL35.2/pcORF25 group was significantly reduced, indicating that serum from the CCL35.2/ORF25 group has better neutralizing efficacy against CyHV-2.

quote: After the vaccination and challenge, TSOD and lysozyme showed an upward trend.
statement: 在疫苗接种和攻毒后，总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）和溶菌酶呈上升趋势。
text_zh: 在疫苗接种和攻毒后，总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）和溶菌酶呈上升趋势。
text_en: After vaccination and challenge, total superoxide dismutase (TSOD) and lysozyme showed an upward trend.

quote: After the treatment with CCL35.2/ORF25, mRNA expression of IL-1β was rapidly up-regulated, indicating that this treatment method can better improve the early inflammatory response.
statement: Treatment with CCL35.2/ORF25 rapidly up-regulated IL-1β mRNA expression, suggesting an improvement in the early inflammatory response.
text_en: Treatment with CCL35.2/ORF25 rapidly up-regulated IL-1β mRNA expression, suggesting an improvement in the early inflammatory response.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: Previous study has shown that the constructed dsDNA vaccine with VAA as antigen gene and CCL4 as immune adjuvant has potential application value in the protection of Japanese flounder eel plague [ 17 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，以VAA为抗原基因、CCL4为免疫佐剂的构建dsDNA疫苗在保护日本鳗鲡鳗弧菌病方面具有潜在应用价值。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，以VAA为抗原基因、CCL4为免疫佐剂的构建dsDNA疫苗在保护日本鳗鲡鳗弧菌病方面具有潜在应用价值。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that a dsDNA vaccine constructed with VAA as the antigen gene and CCL4 as the immune adjuvant has potential application value in protecting Japanese eel against vibriosis.

quote: Therefore, complete ORF25 membrane protein of CyHV-2 was used as antigen to prepare DNA vaccine, and chemokine CCL35.2 (mammalian CCL4 analogue in gibel carp) was used as molecular adjuvant to enhance the immune effect of DNA vaccine in the present study.
statement: 因此，在本研究中，使用CyHV-2完整的ORF25膜蛋白作为抗原来制备DNA疫苗，并使用趋化因子CCL35.2（鲫鱼中的哺乳动物CCL4类似物）作为分子佐剂来增强DNA疫苗的免疫效果。
text_zh: 因此，在本研究中，使用CyHV-2完整的ORF25膜蛋白作为抗原来制备DNA疫苗，并使用趋化因子CCL35.2（鲫鱼中的哺乳动物CCL4类似物）作为分子佐剂来增强DNA疫苗的免疫效果。
text_en: Therefore, in this study, the complete ORF25 membrane protein of CyHV-2 was used as the antigen to prepare a DNA vaccine, and the chemokine CCL35.2 (a mammalian CCL4 analog in crucian carp) was used as a molecular adjuvant to enhance the immune effect of the DNA vaccine.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: In our previous study, the immersion immunization with an inactivated vaccine had a 26% protection rate and a 14% increase after the addition of β-glucan [ 24 ].
statement: 在我们之前的研究中，灭活疫苗浸泡免疫的保护率为26%，添加β-葡聚糖后提高了14%。
text_zh: 在我们之前的研究中，灭活疫苗浸泡免疫的保护率为26%，添加β-葡聚糖后提高了14%。
text_en: In our previous study, the protection rate of immersion vaccination with inactivated vaccine was 26%, and it increased by 14% after adding β-glucan.
intervention_record: 灭活疫苗浸泡加β-葡聚糖

quote: Previous other report showed that the relative survival rates of goldfish immunized with formalin-inactivated CyHV-2 were 42.5% and 57.6%, challenged at 4 and 8 weeks post vaccination, respectively [ 31 ].
statement: 另一项先前的报告显示，用福尔马林灭活的CyHV-2免疫的金鱼在接种后4周和8周攻击时的相对存活率分别为42.5%和57.6%。
text_zh: 另一项先前的报告显示，用福尔马林灭活的CyHV-2免疫的金鱼在接种后4周和8周攻击时的相对存活率分别为42.5%和57.6%。
text_en: Another previous report showed that goldfish immunized with formalin-inactivated CyHV-2 had relative survival rates of 42.5% and 57.6% at challenge 4 weeks and 8 weeks post-vaccination, respectively.

quote: In the present study, ORF25 group demonstrated a 52% protection rate, while the relative survival rate was just 38% in the β-propiolactone inactivated vaccine group.
statement: 本研究中，ORF25组显示52%的保护率，而β-丙内酯灭活疫苗组的相对存活率仅为38%。
text_zh: 本研究中，ORF25组显示52%的保护率，而β-丙内酯灭活疫苗组的相对存活率仅为38%。
text_en: In this study, the ORF25 group showed a protection rate of 52%, while the relative survival rate of the beta-propiolactone inactivated vaccine group was only 38%.

population.species: 鱼类 (未明确具体种类，上下文暗示为实验鱼)

counterevidence: β-丙内酯灭活疫苗组存活率较低

quote: When the molecular adjuvant CCL35.2 was added to the DNA vaccine group and the inactivated vaccine group, the protection rates were increased by 18% and 12%, respectively.
statement: 当将分子佐剂CCL35.2添加到DNA疫苗组和灭活疫苗组时，保护率分别提高了18%和12%。
text_zh: 当将分子佐剂CCL35.2添加到DNA疫苗组和灭活疫苗组时，保护率分别提高了18%和12%。
text_en: When the molecular adjuvant CCL35.2 was added to the DNA vaccine group and the inactivated vaccine group, the protection rates increased by 18% and 12%, respectively.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: The survival rate strongly suggested that our developed DNA vaccine pcORF25 conjugated with molecular adjuvant CCL35.2 could be a rather attractive strategy to improve the viability of fish.
statement: 存活率强烈表明，开发的与分子佐剂CCL35.2结合的DNA疫苗pcORF25可能是提高鱼类生存能力的一种相当有吸引力的策略。
text_zh: 存活率强烈表明，开发的与分子佐剂CCL35.2结合的DNA疫苗pcORF25可能是提高鱼类生存能力的一种相当有吸引力的策略。
text_en: Survival rates strongly suggest that the DNA vaccine pcORF25 developed with the molecular adjuvant CCL35.2 may be a rather attractive strategy for improving fish survival.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: Moreover, all the treatment groups displayed immune protection to some extent, although the various survival rates could be affected by the experimental conditions, methods, etc.
statement: 此外，所有治疗组都在一定程度上表现出免疫保护，尽管不同的存活率可能受到实验条件、方法等的影响。
text_zh: 此外，所有治疗组都在一定程度上表现出免疫保护，尽管不同的存活率可能受到实验条件、方法等的影响。
text_en: In addition, all treatment groups showed a certain degree of immune protection, although different survival rates may be influenced by experimental conditions, methods, etc.
limitations: 存活率受实验条件和方法影响

quote: For this fish, progress on improving feed efficiency has mainly focused on changes in external conditions
statement: 对于鲫鱼，提高饲料效率的进展主要集中在外部条件的改变上。
text_zh: 对于鲫鱼，提高饲料效率的进展主要集中在外部条件的改变上。
text_en: For crucian carp, progress in improving feed efficiency has mainly focused on changes to external conditions.

quote: During the experimental period, all test fish were fed three times (10:00 am, 15:00 pm and 20:00 pm) a day by the same fish-feeder, and the fish-feeder stopped feeding when the fish satiated each meal.
statement: 实验期间，所有测试鱼每天由同一人投喂三次，且在每餐鱼吃饱时停止投喂。
text_zh: 实验期间，所有测试鱼每天由同一人投喂三次，且在每餐鱼吃饱时停止投喂。
text_en: During the experiment, all test fish were fed three times a day by the same person, and feeding was stopped when the fish were full at each meal.

quote: The 4-month-old fish, which had acclimated to indoor water quality conditions for 48 h, were disinfected by immersion in 0.01% potassium permanganate for 20 min.
statement: 实验用鱼在室内水质条件下驯化48小时，并浸入0.01%高锰酸钾溶液中消毒20分钟。
text_zh: 实验用鱼在室内水质条件下驯化48小时，并浸入0.01%高锰酸钾溶液中消毒20分钟。
text_en: Experimental fish were acclimated for 48 hours under indoor water quality conditions and immersed in a 0.01% potassium permanganate solution for disinfection for 20 minutes.

population.system: 实验室养殖/细胞培养前处理

quote: The fish were subsequently anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 for 5 min and transferred to a sterile operating platform, where the body surface was further disinfected with 75% ethanol.
statement: 鱼随后使用100 mg/L的MS-222麻醉5分钟，转移至无菌操作台，并用75%乙醇进一步消毒体表。
text_zh: 鱼随后使用100 mg/L的MS-222麻醉5分钟，转移至无菌操作台，并用75%乙醇进一步消毒体表。
text_en: The fish were then anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 for 5 minutes, transferred to a sterile operating table, and further disinfected on the body surface with 75% ethanol.

population.system: 实验室养殖/细胞培养前处理

quote: Since feed cost comprises about 65–75% of the total production cost in most aquaculture species [ 7 ], the increasing production demand with huge input cost kept up pressures on us to investigate how to improve feed efficiency.
statement: 饲料成本占大多数养殖物种总生产成本的65-75%，巨大的投入成本促使人们研究如何提高饲料效率。
text_zh: 饲料成本占大多数养殖物种总生产成本的65-75%，巨大的投入成本促使人们研究如何提高饲料效率。
text_en: Feed costs account for 65-75% of the total production cost for most farmed species, and the high input cost has prompted research into improving feed efficiency.
outcome: 经济压力与饲料效率需求

quote: At 82 days post hatch (dph), these reference fish (mean body weight of 0.87 ± 0.39 g) were individually reared in the same environment with pallet feed in a series of re-circulating aquarium tanks in order to achieve accurate feed consumption.
statement: 为了准确测量摄食量，鲫鱼在孵化后82天被单独饲养在循环水族箱中并投喂颗粒饲料。
text_zh: 为了准确测量摄食量，鲫鱼在孵化后82天被单独饲养在循环水族箱中并投喂颗粒饲料。
text_en: To accurately measure feed intake, crucian carp were individually housed in recirculating aquaria and fed pelleted feed at 82 days post-hatching.

quote: Such detailed conditions of the aquarium tanks as water temperature (27–28 °C), dissolved oxygen (7–8 mg/L) and water flow rate (1 ms −1), were regularly maintained throughout the feeding test for two months.
statement: 在整个为期两个月的摄食测试期间，定期维持水温（27-28°C）、溶解氧（7-8 mg/L）和水流速度（1 m/s）等详细条件。
text_zh: 在整个为期两个月的摄食测试期间，定期维持水温（27-28°C）、溶解氧（7-8 mg/L）和水流速度（1 m/s）等详细条件。
text_en: During the entire two-month feeding test period, detailed conditions such as water temperature (27-28°C), dissolved oxygen (7-8 mg/L), and flow velocity (1 m/s) were regularly maintained.

quote: Furthermore, hypoxia treatment experiments were conducted to evaluate the applicability of COBC as an in vitro model for environmental stress studies.
statement: 此外，进行了缺氧处理实验以评估COBC作为环境应激研究体外模型的适用性。
text_zh: 此外，进行了缺氧处理实验以评估COBC作为环境应激研究体外模型的适用性。
text_en: In addition, hypoxia treatment experiments were conducted to evaluate the applicability of COBC as an in vitro model for environmental stress studies.

quote: All efforts were made to minimize the suffering of the animals.
statement: 已尽一切努力减少动物的痛苦。
text_zh: 已尽一切努力减少动物的痛苦。
text_en: Every effort has been made to reduce animal suffering.
intervention_record: 减少动物负面影响措施

quote: they are pathogenic to gibel carp and closely-related fish species, causing fish mortality especially in fish aquaculture
statement: 单殖吸虫对鲫鱼及其近缘物种具有致病性，特别是在水产养殖中导致鱼类死亡。
text_zh: 单殖吸虫对鲫鱼及其近缘物种具有致病性，特别是在水产养殖中导致鱼类死亡。
text_en: Monogeneans are pathogenic to crucian carp and its closely related species, particularly causing fish mortality in aquaculture.

quote: GSH content increased after 12 h of hypoxic stress, potentially reflecting an acute compensatory response to elevated reactive oxygen species (ROS) production
statement: 在缺氧应激12小时后，谷胱甘肽（GSH）含量增加，这可能反映了对活性氧（ROS）产生增加的急性补偿反应。
text_zh: 在缺氧应激12小时后，谷胱甘肽（GSH）含量增加，这可能反映了对活性氧（ROS）产生增加的急性补偿反应。
text_en: After 12 hours of hypoxic stress, glutathione (GSH) content increased, which may reflect an acute compensatory response to increased reactive oxygen species (ROS) production.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化防御

quote: the activities of the antioxidant enzymes SOD and CAT progressively declined with prolonged hypoxia duration, suggesting impairment of the enzymatic antioxidant defense system under sustained oxidative stress
statement: 随着缺氧持续时间延长，抗氧化酶SOD和CAT的活性逐渐下降，表明在持续氧化应激下酶促抗氧化防御系统受损。
text_zh: 随着缺氧持续时间延长，抗氧化酶SOD和CAT的活性逐渐下降，表明在持续氧化应激下酶促抗氧化防御系统受损。
text_en: As the duration of hypoxia prolonged, the activities of antioxidant enzymes SOD and CAT gradually decreased, indicating that the enzymatic antioxidant defense system was impaired under sustained oxidative stress.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化防御

quote: The concomitant increase in LDH activity indicates membrane damage and metabolic disruption, which are commonly associated with hypoxia-induced oxidative injury
statement: LDH活性的伴随增加表明膜损伤和代谢紊乱，这通常与缺氧诱导的氧化损伤有关。
text_zh: LDH活性的伴随增加表明膜损伤和代谢紊乱，这通常与缺氧诱导的氧化损伤有关。
text_en: The accompanying increase in LDH activity indicates membrane damage and metabolic disturbance, which is usually associated with hypoxia-induced oxidative damage.

quote: these results suggest that hypoxic stress in COBCs induces a transient antioxidant response (elevated GSH content), followed by a decline in enzymatic antioxidant capacity (reduced SOD and CAT activities) and exacerbated cellular damage (increased LDH activity), indicating progressive disruption of intracellular redox homeostasis under sustained hypoxic conditions
statement: 这些结果表明，COBCs中的缺氧应激诱导了短暂的抗氧化反应（GSH含量升高），随后是酶促抗氧化能力的下降（SOD和CAT活性降低）和加剧的细胞损伤（LDH活性增加），表明在持续缺氧条件下细胞内氧化还原稳态受到进行性破坏。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，COBCs中的缺氧应激诱导了短暂的抗氧化反应（GSH含量升高），随后是酶促抗氧化能力的下降（SOD和CAT活性降低）和加剧的细胞损伤（LDH活性增加），表明在持续缺氧条件下细胞内氧化还原稳态受到进行性破坏。
text_en: These results indicate that hypoxic stress in COBCs induced a transient antioxidant response (increased GSH content), followed by a decline in enzymatic antioxidant capacity (decreased SOD and CAT activities) and aggravated cellular damage (increased LDH activity), suggesting progressive disruption of intracellular redox homeostasis under sustained hypoxic conditions.

quote: The recovery of SOD and CAT activities following reoxygenation further supports the reversibility of hypoxia-induced oxidative imbalance and suggests a partial restoration of cellular redox equilibrium
statement: 复氧后SOD和CAT活性的恢复进一步支持了缺氧诱导的氧化失衡的可逆性，并暗示细胞氧化还原平衡的部分恢复。
text_zh: 复氧后SOD和CAT活性的恢复进一步支持了缺氧诱导的氧化失衡的可逆性，并暗示细胞氧化还原平衡的部分恢复。
text_en: The recovery of SOD and CAT activities after reoxygenation further supports the reversibility of hypoxia-induced oxidative imbalance and suggests a partial restoration of cellular redox balance.

quote: The mRNA expression levels of osteogenesis-related genes runx2a , runx2b , and sp7 in COBCs were significantly downregulated under acute hypoxic conditions compared with the normoxic control at all time points.
statement: 在所有时间点，与常氧对照相比，急性缺氧条件下COBCs中成骨相关基因runx2a、runx2b和sp7的mRNA表达水平均显著下调。
text_zh: 在所有时间点，与常氧对照相比，急性缺氧条件下COBCs中成骨相关基因runx2a、runx2b和sp7的mRNA表达水平均显著下调。
text_en: At all time points, compared with the normoxic control, the mRNA expression levels of osteogenesis-related genes runx2a, runx2b and sp7 in COBCs were significantly downregulated under acute hypoxia.

quote: the observed suppression of osteogenesis-related genes (e.g., runx2a , runx2b , and sp7) likely reflects altered osteoblast-like cellular responses to hypoxic stress rather than direct evidence of impaired osteoblast differentiation
statement: 成骨相关基因的抑制可能反映了类成骨细胞对缺氧应激的反应改变，而非成骨分化的直接受损证据。
text_zh: 成骨相关基因的抑制可能反映了类成骨细胞对缺氧应激的反应改变，而非成骨分化的直接受损证据。
text_en: The suppression of osteogenesis-related genes may reflect altered responses of osteoblast-like cells to hypoxic stress, rather than direct evidence of impaired osteogenic differentiation.

quote: the upregulation of hif1a and casp3 suggests activation of hypoxia-responsive and apoptosis-related pathways
statement: hif1a和casp3的上调表明缺氧响应和凋亡相关通路的激活。
text_zh: hif1a和casp3的上调表明缺氧响应和凋亡相关通路的激活。
text_en: The upregulation of hif1a and casp3 indicates the activation of hypoxia response and apoptosis-related pathways.

quote: Comparable hypoxia-induced apoptotic responses have been reported in multiple fish cell types, including osteoclasts and gill cells
statement: 在包括破骨细胞和鳃细胞在内的多种鱼类细胞类型中已报道了类似的缺氧诱导的凋亡反应。
text_zh: 在包括破骨细胞和鳃细胞在内的多种鱼类细胞类型中已报道了类似的缺氧诱导的凋亡反应。
text_en: Similar hypoxia-induced apoptotic responses have been reported in various fish cell types, including osteoclasts and gill cells.

quote: Following reoxygenation, COBCs exhibited fibroblast-like morphology. This morphological alteration may represent a stress-associated phenotypic adaptation rather than the emergence of a distinct cell population.
statement: 复氧后，COBCs表现出成纤维细胞样形态，这种形态改变可能代表与应激相关的表型适应，而非新细胞群体的出现。
text_zh: 复氧后，COBCs表现出成纤维细胞样形态，这种形态改变可能代表与应激相关的表型适应，而非新细胞群体的出现。
text_en: After reoxygenation, COBCs exhibited a fibroblast-like morphology; this morphological change may represent a stress-related phenotypic adaptation rather than the emergence of a new cell population.

statement: 三倍体鲫鱼（gynogenetic triploids）的寄生虫物种丰富度、总寄生虫丰度和Dactylogyrus属寄生虫丰度均高于二倍体有性繁殖鲫鱼（sexual diploids）。
text_zh: 三倍体鲫鱼（gynogenetic triploids）的寄生虫物种丰富度、总寄生虫丰度和Dactylogyrus属寄生虫丰度均高于二倍体有性繁殖鲫鱼（sexual diploids）。
text_en: The parasite species richness, total parasite abundance, and abundance of Dactylogyrus parasites were higher in gynogenetic triploid crucian carp than in sexual diploid crucian carp.
counterevidence: 数据显示三倍体比二倍体携带更多的寄生虫。

quote: The intensities of infection for four of the five dominant Dactylogyrus species tended to be higher in triploids than in diploids.
statement: 五种优势指环虫属（Dactylogyrus）物种中有四种的感染强度在三倍体鱼中倾向于高于二倍体鱼。
text_zh: 五种优势指环虫属（Dactylogyrus）物种中有四种的感染强度在三倍体鱼中倾向于高于二倍体鱼。
text_en: In four of the five dominant Dactylogyrus species, infection intensity tended to be higher in triploid fish than in diploid fish.

quote: Moreover, triploids were occasionally parasitized by four rare endoparasite species that were absent in diploids (Table 5).
statement: 此外，三倍体鱼偶尔被四种在二倍体鱼中不存在的罕见内寄生虫物种寄生。
text_zh: 此外，三倍体鱼偶尔被四种在二倍体鱼中不存在的罕见内寄生虫物种寄生。
text_en: In addition, triploid fish are occasionally parasitized by four rare endoparasite species that do not exist in diploid fish.

quote: However, two common clones of gynogens were significantly more parasitized than sexual diploids or other gynogens with rare MHC genotypes.
statement: 然而，两个常见的雌核发育克隆比有性二倍体或其他具有罕见MHC基因型的雌核发育个体受到更严重的寄生。
text_zh: 然而，两个常见的雌核发育克隆比有性二倍体或其他具有罕见MHC基因型的雌核发育个体受到更严重的寄生。
text_en: However, two common gynogenetic clones suffered more severe parasitism than sexual diploids or other gynogenetic individuals with rare MHC genotypes.

quote: The lowest expression levels were observed after 24 h of hypoxia (p p p Figure 7 A–C).
statement: 在缺氧24小时后观察到最低的表达水平。
text_zh: 在缺氧24小时后观察到最低的表达水平。
text_en: The lowest expression levels were observed after 24 hours of hypoxia.
outcome: 细胞分化/骨骼发育基因表达

quote: The hypoxia-related gene bcl2 displayed a similar expression pattern, characterized by suppression under hypoxia and partial recovery following reoxygenation (Figure 7 E).
statement: 缺氧相关基因bcl2表现出类似的表达模式，即在缺氧下受到抑制，并在复氧后部分恢复。
text_zh: 缺氧相关基因bcl2表现出类似的表达模式，即在缺氧下受到抑制，并在复氧后部分恢复。
text_en: The hypoxia-related gene bcl2 showed a similar expression pattern, namely being suppressed under hypoxia and partially recovering after reoxygenation.
outcome: 细胞凋亡调控基因表达

quote: In contrast, the expression levels of casp3 and hif1a increased progressively with prolonged hypoxic exposure (p Figure 7 D,F).
statement: 相比之下，casp3和hif1a的表达水平随着缺氧暴露时间的延长而逐渐增加。
text_zh: 相比之下，casp3和hif1a的表达水平随着缺氧暴露时间的延长而逐渐增加。
text_en: In contrast, the expression levels of casp3 and hif1a gradually increased with prolonged hypoxia exposure time.
outcome: 应激与凋亡相关基因表达

quote: Enzyme activity assays demonstrated that the activities of SOD and CAT in COBCs decreased progressively with increasing hypoxia duration compared with the normoxic control (p p > 0.05; Figure 8 A,B).
statement: 酶活性测定表明，与常氧对照相比，COBC中SOD和CAT的活性随着缺氧持续时间的增加而逐渐降低。
text_zh: 酶活性测定表明，与常氧对照相比，COBC中SOD和CAT的活性随着缺氧持续时间的增加而逐渐降低。
text_en: Enzyme activity measurements showed that, compared with the normoxic control, SOD and CAT activities in COBC gradually decreased as the duration of hypoxia increased.

quote: The GSH content and LDH activity reached their highest levels after 12 h of hypoxic exposure and subsequently declined after 24 h of reoxygenation, ultimately returning to values comparable to those observed under normoxic conditions (Figure 8 C,D).
statement: GSH含量和LDH活性在缺氧暴露12小时后达到最高水平，随后在复氧24小时后下降，最终恢复到与常氧条件下观察到的值相当的水平。
text_zh: GSH含量和LDH活性在缺氧暴露12小时后达到最高水平，随后在复氧24小时后下降，最终恢复到与常氧条件下观察到的值相当的水平。
text_en: GSH content and LDH activity reached their highest levels after 12 hours of hypoxia exposure, then decreased after 24 hours of reoxygenation, finally returning to levels comparable to those observed under normoxic conditions.

quote: Hakoyama et al . [ 3 ] showed that the high prevalence of Metagonnimus (Trematoda) in Japanese crucian carp (Carassius auratus) is in part due to the lower immune activity of the phagocytes in the gynogenetic form.
statement: 日本鲫鱼中吸虫的高流行率部分归因于雌核发育型个体吞噬细胞免疫活性较低。
text_zh: 日本鲫鱼中吸虫的高流行率部分归因于雌核发育型个体吞噬细胞免疫活性较低。
text_en: The high prevalence of trematodes in Japanese crucian carp is partly attributed to lower phagocytic immune activity in gynogenetic individuals.

quote: we suggest analyzing measurements of specific (IgM level) and non-specific immunity (phagocyte activity) to investigate whether enhanced parasite load in gynogenetic females reflects an immune disadvantage.
statement: 建议通过测量特异性（IgM水平）和非特异性免疫（吞噬细胞活性）来研究雌核发育雌性较高的寄生虫负荷是否反映了免疫劣势。
text_zh: 建议通过测量特异性（IgM水平）和非特异性免疫（吞噬细胞活性）来研究雌核发育雌性较高的寄生虫负荷是否反映了免疫劣势。
text_en: It is suggested to investigate whether the higher parasite load in gynogenetic females reflects an immune disadvantage by measuring specific immunity (IgM levels) and non-specific immunity (phagocyte activity).

quote: A significantly higher parasite abundance was found for triploid individuals with common genotype “B” when compared to sexual diploids (t-value = 2.419, df = 54, p = 0.019) or gynogenetic triploids with common genotype “A” (t-value = 2.150, df = 35, p = 0.039).
statement: 与有性二倍体或具有常见基因型“A”的雌核发育三倍体相比，具有常见基因型“B”的三倍体个体的寄生虫丰度显著更高。
text_zh: 与有性二倍体或具有常见基因型“A”的雌核发育三倍体相比，具有常见基因型“B”的三倍体个体的寄生虫丰度显著更高。
text_en: Compared to sexual diploids or gynogenetic triploids with common genotype "A", triploid individuals with common genotype "B" had significantly higher parasite abundance.

quote: A significantly higher Dactylogyrus abundance was found for triploids with common genotype “B” when compared to sexual diploids (t-value = 2.476, df = 54, p = 0.016) or gynogenetic triploids with common genotype “A” (t-value = 2.213, df = 35, p = 0.034).
statement: 与有性二倍体和具有常见基因型“A”的雌核发育三倍体相比，具有常见基因型“B”的三倍体的指环虫（Dactylogyrus）丰度显著更高。
text_zh: 与有性二倍体和具有常见基因型“A”的雌核发育三倍体相比，具有常见基因型“B”的三倍体的指环虫（Dactylogyrus）丰度显著更高。
text_en: The abundance of Dactylogyrus was significantly higher in triploids with common genotype "B" compared to sexual diploids and gynogenetic triploids with common genotype "A".
outcome: 特定寄生虫（指环虫）感染水平
limitations: 仅部分差异在多重比较校正后保持显著
counterevidence: After Bonferroni correction, only the difference between gynogenetic triploids with common genotype “B” and sexual diploids was significant (p = 0.048).

quote: Dactylogyrus parasitizing Carassius species and closely related common carp are considered to be the most pathogenic monogenean species on the gills causing fish mortality
statement: 寄生于鲫鱼属及近缘鲤鱼的指环虫被认为是鳃部致病性最强的单殖吸虫，会导致鱼类死亡。
text_zh: 寄生于鲫鱼属及近缘鲤鱼的指环虫被认为是鳃部致病性最强的单殖吸虫，会导致鱼类死亡。
text_en: Dactygyrus parasites on Carassius and closely related cyprinids are considered the most pathogenic monogeneans of the gills, causing fish mortality.

quote: A total of 92 individuals of gibel carp were caught by electro-fishing from the Soutok locality (Dyje River, Czech Republic) in July and August 2005 and 2006.
statement: 研究通过电捕法从捷克共和国迪耶河Soutok地区捕获了92条银鲫。
text_zh: 研究通过电捕法从捷克共和国迪耶河Soutok地区捕获了92条银鲫。
text_en: The study captured 92 silver crucian carp from the Soutok area of the Dyje River in the Czech Republic using electrofishing.

quote: No significant difference in parasite abundance or parasite diversity was found between diploids and triploids (t-test, p > 0.05).
statement: 二倍体和三倍体之间在寄生虫丰度或多样性方面未发现显著差异。
text_zh: 二倍体和三倍体之间在寄生虫丰度或多样性方面未发现显著差异。
text_en: No significant difference was found between diploids and triploids in terms of parasite abundance or diversity.

quote: Significantly higher parasite species richness was found in gynogenetic triploids expressing the common genotype “A” than in sexual diploids (t-value = 2.955, df = 67, p = 0.004) and gynogenetic triploids with the rare genotype (t-value = 2.218, df = 33, p = 0.033).
statement: 表达常见基因型“A”的雌核发育三倍体比有性二倍体和具有罕见基因型的雌核发育三倍体表现出显著更高的寄生虫物种丰富度。
text_zh: 表达常见基因型“A”的雌核发育三倍体比有性二倍体和具有罕见基因型的雌核发育三倍体表现出显著更高的寄生虫物种丰富度。
text_en: Gynogenetic triploids expressing the common genotype "A" showed significantly higher parasite species richness than sexual diploids and gynogenetic triploids with rare genotypes.

quote: Fish were examined for all metazoan ectoparasites (Monogenea, Crustacea, Mollusca and Hirudinea) and endoparasites (Digenea, Cestoda, Acantocephala and Nematoda).
statement: 检查鱼类的所有多细胞外寄生虫和内寄生虫。
text_zh: 检查鱼类的所有多细胞外寄生虫和内寄生虫。
text_en: Examine all multicellular ectoparasites and endoparasites of fish.

quote: For each fish individual, parasite species richness and total parasite abundance (i.e. total number of parasite individuals in a given fish individual) were calculated.
statement: 计算每条鱼的寄生虫物种丰富度和总寄生虫丰度。
text_zh: 计算每条鱼的寄生虫物种丰富度和总寄生虫丰度。
text_en: Calculate the parasite species richness and total parasite abundance for each fish.

quote: Moreover, it supports the study of Lampert et al . [ 10 ] suggesting that a higher allelic copy number in clonal fish might not convey an immune advantage (measured by parasite load in our study).
statement: 此外，这支持了Lampert等人的研究，表明克隆鱼中较高的等位基因拷贝数可能不会带来免疫优势（在本研究中通过寄生虫负荷衡量）。
text_zh: 此外，这支持了Lampert等人的研究，表明克隆鱼中较高的等位基因拷贝数可能不会带来免疫优势（在本研究中通过寄生虫负荷衡量）。
text_en: In addition, this supports the study by Lampert et al., indicating that a higher allele copy number in cloned fish may not confer an immunological advantage (measured in this study by parasite load).

quote: Конечная концентрация по действующему веществу – иону Zn2+ составляла 0,005 мг/л, что соответствовало 1/50 от установленной 96-час LC50.
statement: Конечная концентрация иона цинка в аквариуме составляла 0,005 мг/л, что равнялось 1/50 от 96-часовой LC50.
text_en: Конечная концентрация иона цинка в аквариуме составляла 0,005 мг/л, что равнялось 1/50 от 96-часовой LC50.

quote: После 30 дней экспозиции с токсикантом, опытных рыб помещали в чистую воду на 45 сут («отмывка»).
statement: После 30 дней воздействия токсиканта рыбу перемещали в чистую воду на 45 суток для отмывки.
text_en: После 30 дней воздействия токсиканта рыбу перемещали в чистую воду на 45 суток для отмывки.

quote: Chronic dietary exposure in the range of 8–49 mg Pb kg −1 resulted in no significant effects on the growth and survival of Prussian carp females.
statement: 慢性饮食暴露于8-49 mg Pb kg−1的铅对普鲁士鲤鱼雌鱼的生长和存活率没有显著影响。
text_zh: 慢性饮食暴露于8-49 mg Pb kg−1的铅对普鲁士鲤鱼雌鱼的生长和存活率没有显著影响。
text_en: Chronic dietary exposure to lead at 8-49 mg Pb kg−1 had no significant effect on the growth and survival of female Prussian carp.

quote: Because lead crosses the blood–brain barrier, it can cause various detrimental effects to the body condition, health, and life of fish (Hodson et al. 1978 ; Needleman and Bellinger 1991 ; Rabitto et al. 2005).
statement: 由于铅能穿过血脑屏障，它可能对鱼的身体状况、健康和生命造成各种有害影响。
text_zh: 由于铅能穿过血脑屏障，它可能对鱼的身体状况、健康和生命造成各种有害影响。
text_en: Because lead can cross the blood-brain barrier, it may cause various harmful effects on the body condition, health and life of fish.

quote: case when the genetic diversity of asexual lineages is low, the asexually reproducing form is more intensely infected than the sexual form [ 3 , 16 ].
statement: 当无性繁殖系的遗传多样性较低时，无性繁殖形式的感染程度比有性形式更严重。
text_zh: 当无性繁殖系的遗传多样性较低时，无性繁殖形式的感染程度比有性形式更严重。
text_en: When the genetic diversity of asexual lineages is low, the infection severity in asexual forms is greater than in sexual forms.

quote: Two common MHC IIB genotypes were more parasitized than the genotypes of sexual diploids and rare genotypes of gynogenetic triploid females, which is in line with the prediction of the Red Queen hypothesis.
statement: 两种常见的MHC IIB基因型比有性二倍体和雌核发育三倍体雌性的稀有基因型受到更多的寄生，这与红皇后假说的预测一致。
text_zh: 两种常见的MHC IIB基因型比有性二倍体和雌核发育三倍体雌性的稀有基因型受到更多的寄生，这与红皇后假说的预测一致。
text_en: Two common MHC IIB genotypes experienced more parasitism than rare genotypes in sexual diploid and gynogenetic triploid females, consistent with the predictions of the Red Queen hypothesis.

quote: Chronic dietary exposure in the range of 8–49 mg Pb kg −1 resulted in no significant effects on the growth of Prussian carp females (Table 2).
statement: 慢性饮食暴露于8-49 mg Pb kg−1范围内对普鲁士鲤雌鱼的生长没有显著影响。
text_zh: 慢性饮食暴露于8-49 mg Pb kg−1范围内对普鲁士鲤雌鱼的生长没有显著影响。
text_en: Chronic dietary exposure to lead in the range of 8-49 mg Pb kg−1 had no significant effect on the growth of female Prussian carp.

quote: The total mortality rate was equal to nine pieces (Table 2).
statement: 总死亡率为九条鱼。
text_zh: 总死亡率为九条鱼。
text_en: The total mortality was nine fish.

quote: The highest lead concentrations were observed at 2.0 ± 0.54 to 7.4 ± 1.1 mg kg −1 in the kidney, 3.0 ± 0.13 to 5.2 ± 0.17 mg kg −1 in the bone, and 4.5 (±0.4) mg kg −1 in the hepatopancreas of fish from groups exposed to lead dietary concentration from 8 to 49 mg kg −1 for 24 months.
statement: 在暴露于8至49 mg/kg膳食铅浓度24个月的鱼群中，肾脏、骨骼和肝胰腺中的最高铅浓度分别为2.0±0.54至7.4±1.1 mg/kg、3.0±0.13至5.2±0.17 mg/kg和4.5(±0.4) mg/kg。
text_zh: 在暴露于8至49 mg/kg膳食铅浓度24个月的鱼群中，肾脏、骨骼和肝胰腺中的最高铅浓度分别为2.0±0.54至7.4±1.1 mg/kg、3.0±0.13至5.2±0.17 mg/kg和4.5(±0.4) mg/kg。
text_en: In fish exposed to dietary lead concentrations of 8 to 49 mg/kg for 24 months, the highest lead concentrations in the kidney, bone, and hepatopancreas were 2.0±0.54 to 7.4±1.1 mg/kg, 3.0±0.13 to 5.2±0.17 mg/kg, and 4.5(±0.4) mg/kg, respectively.

quote: При пересадке рыб в чистую воду на 75 сут показатель ИК снизился, но оставался выше контроля на 9.7%.
statement: Пересадка рыб в чистую воду привела к снижению показателя иммунных комплексов (ИК) на 75-е сутки, однако он все еще оставался выше контрольного уровня на 9.7%.
text_en: Пересадка рыб в чистую воду привела к снижению показателя иммунных комплексов (ИК) на 75-е сутки, однако он все еще оставался выше контрольного уровня на 9.7%.
counterevidence: показатель ИК оставался выше контроля на 9.7%

quote: Throughout the study, fish were fed once daily a ration that amounted to 3 % of their body weight.
statement: 在整个研究期间，鱼每天喂食一次，投喂量为体重的3%。
text_zh: 在整个研究期间，鱼每天喂食一次，投喂量为体重的3%。
text_en: Throughout the study period, fish were fed once daily at a rate of 3% of body weight.

quote: To avoid repeated exposure of fish to the intake of excreted lead from water, aquarium water was changed every 2 weeks.
statement: 为避免鱼类重复摄入从水中排出的铅，每两周更换一次水族箱的水。
text_zh: 为避免鱼类重复摄入从水中排出的铅，每两周更换一次水族箱的水。
text_en: To prevent fish from repeatedly ingesting lead excreted into the water, change the aquarium water every two weeks.
outcome: 水质控制与污染物暴露减少

quote: На дефицит антиоксидантов у опытных карасей указывают повышенные показатели КОС.
statement: Повышенные показатели КОС свидетельствуют о дефиците антиоксидантов у опытных карасей.
text_en: Повышенные показатели КОС свидетельствуют о дефиците антиоксидантов у опытных карасей.

quote: we chose concentrations simulating the average degree of environmental contamination (8, 13, 24, and 49 mg kg −1) to find out if their constant presence in fish diets will significantly affect the bioaccumulation and subsequent elimination of lead from Prussian carp tissues, and whether the bioaccumulation will vary according to the dose of exposure.
statement: Concentrations simulating average environmental contamination (8, 13, 24, and 49 mg/kg) were chosen to test effects on lead bioaccumulation and elimination.
text_en: Concentrations simulating average environmental contamination (8, 13, 24, and 49 mg/kg) were chosen to test effects on lead bioaccumulation and elimination.

quote: Mean lead concentration in bottom sediments of aquariums in groups 1–5 were amounted to 1.54 (±0.2), 13.74 (±0.8), 24.21 (±2.3), 30.88 (±3.0), and 71.80 (±4.4) mg Pb kg −1 dw, respectively.
statement: 水族箱底部沉积物中的平均铅浓度在组1至5中分别为1.54、13.74、24.21、30.88和71.80 mg Pb kg−1 dw。
text_zh: 水族箱底部沉积物中的平均铅浓度在组1至5中分别为1.54、13.74、24.21、30.88和71.80 mg Pb kg−1 dw。
text_en: The average lead concentration in aquarium bottom sediments was 1.54, 13.74, 24.21, 30.88 and 71.80 mg Pb kg−1 dw in groups 1 to 5, respectively.

quote: The tissues that accumulated more Pb were kidney, bone, and hepatopancreas, reaching values of 7 (±0.72), 5 (±0.0.43), and 4.5 (±0.4) mg kg −1 ww, respectively, after 12–24 months of exposure
statement: 积累更多铅的组织是肾脏、骨骼和肝胰腺，在暴露12-24个月后分别达到7、5和4.5 mg kg−1 ww的值。
text_zh: 积累更多铅的组织是肾脏、骨骼和肝胰腺，在暴露12-24个月后分别达到7、5和4.5 mg kg−1 ww的值。
text_en: The tissues that accumulated more lead were the kidney, bone, and hepatopancreas, reaching values of 7, 5, and 4.5 mg kg−1 ww respectively after 12-24 months of exposure.

quote: Statistical significant differences in the lead accumulation levels between groups were observed in all studied tissues
statement: 在所有研究的组织中，各组之间的铅积累水平存在统计学显著差异。
text_zh: 在所有研究的组织中，各组之间的铅积累水平存在统计学显著差异。
text_en: In all tissues studied, there were statistically significant differences in lead accumulation levels between groups.

quote: Researchers interested in studying only long-term contamination may limit themselves to sampling scales to monitor the contamination of fish in a way that poses no threat to their health and lives.
statement: 研究人员可以仅通过采集鳞片来监测鱼类污染，这种方式对鱼的健康和生命没有威胁。
text_zh: 研究人员可以仅通过采集鳞片来监测鱼类污染，这种方式对鱼的健康和生命没有威胁。
text_en: Researchers can monitor fish contamination solely by collecting scales, a method that poses no threat to the health or life of the fish.

quote: Fish were stocked in fourteen 300-l aquaria (30 fish per aquarium) at water supplied from the Municipal Waterworks in Cracow, an average temperature of 17 °C, pH of 7.7, dissolved oxygen of 10.5 mg l −1 , and water hardness of 127 mg CaCO 3 l −1 .
statement: 鱼被饲养在14个300升的水族箱中（每个水族箱30条），使用克拉科夫市政供水，平均水温17°C，pH值7.7，溶解氧10.5 mg/l，水硬度127 mg CaCO3/l。
text_zh: 鱼被饲养在14个300升的水族箱中（每个水族箱30条），使用克拉科夫市政供水，平均水温17°C，pH值7.7，溶解氧10.5 mg/l，水硬度127 mg CaCO3/l。
text_en: Fish were reared in 14 300-liter aquaria (30 fish per aquarium), using Krakow municipal water supply, with an average water temperature of 17°C, pH 7.7, dissolved oxygen 10.5 mg/l, and water hardness 127 mg CaCO3/l.
intervention: High-density farming with water quality control
intervention_record: 高密度养殖与水质控制

quote: In addition, the water was aerated and filtered.
statement: 此外，水体经过曝气和过滤处理。
text_zh: 此外，水体经过曝气和过滤处理。
text_en: In addition, the water was aerated and filtered.

quote: The experiment was preceded by a 4-month adaptation period when fish were fed a control diet (lead concentration of 0.1 mg kg −1 dw).
statement: 实验前进行了为期4个月的适应期，期间鱼饲喂对照饲料（铅浓度为0.1 mg/kg干重）。
text_zh: 实验前进行了为期4个月的适应期，期间鱼饲喂对照饲料（铅浓度为0.1 mg/kg干重）。
text_en: A 4-month adaptation period was conducted before the experiment, during which fish were fed a control diet (lead concentration of 0.1 mg/kg dry weight).

quote: No significant differences were observed in fish body weights after 12 and 24 months of experiment (Table 2).
statement: 在实验的12个月和24个月后，未观察到鱼体重的显著差异。
text_zh: 在实验的12个月和24个月后，未观察到鱼体重的显著差异。
text_en: No significant difference in fish body weight was observed after 12 and 24 months of the experiment.

quote: The total mortality rate was equal to nine pieces (Table 2) and was not associated with the dietary Pb treatments throughout the course of the experiment what is consistent with other dietary studies results (Hodson et al. 1978 ; Mount et al. 1994 ; Alves et al. 2006).
statement: 总死亡率为九条（表2），且在整个实验过程中与膳食铅处理无关，这与其他膳食研究结果一致。
text_zh: 总死亡率为九条（表2），且在整个实验过程中与膳食铅处理无关，这与其他膳食研究结果一致。
text_en: The total mortality was nine (Table 2), and it was unrelated to dietary lead treatment throughout the experiment, which is consistent with results from other dietary studies.

quote: Growth rates and mortality do not appear to be sensitive indicators of dietary Pb toxicity in Prussian carp.
statement: 生长率和死亡率似乎不是普鲁士鲤鱼膳食铅毒性的敏感指标。
text_zh: 生长率和死亡率似乎不是普鲁士鲤鱼膳食铅毒性的敏感指标。
text_en: Growth rate and mortality do not appear to be sensitive indicators of dietary lead toxicity in Prussian carp.

quote: Scales collected from live fish can be used for monitoring contamination of fish without killing them, i.e., without loss of ichthyofauna.
statement: 从活鱼身上采集鳞片可用于监测鱼类污染，而无需杀死它们。
text_zh: 从活鱼身上采集鳞片可用于监测鱼类污染，而无需杀死它们。
text_en: Scales collected from live fish can be used to monitor fish pollution without killing them.

quote: In the case of bone and scales tissues with lower doses of exposure in groups 2, 3, and 4 (and 5 in case of scales) monthly increments of bioaccumulation were highly significant only after 6 months; whereas in group 5, intensive bioaccumulation was already observed during the first 3 months of contamination in the bone
statement: 在骨骼和鳞片组织中，第2、3、4组（以及鳞片的第5组）较低剂量的暴露仅在6个月后显示出高度显著的月度生物积累增量；而在第5组中，骨骼在污染的前3个月内已经观察到强烈的生物积累。
text_zh: 在骨骼和鳞片组织中，第2、3、4组（以及鳞片的第5组）较低剂量的暴露仅在6个月后显示出高度显著的月度生物积累增量；而在第5组中，骨骼在污染的前3个月内已经观察到强烈的生物积累。
text_en: In bone and scale tissues, lower-dose exposure in groups 2, 3, and 4 (and group 5 for scales) showed highly significant monthly bioaccumulation increments only after 6 months; whereas in group 5, strong bioaccumulation was already observed in bones within the first 3 months of contamination.
outcome: 骨骼和鳞片铅生物积累的时间依赖性

quote: The highest monthly decreases in accumulation were observed in the first 3 months of elimination in kidneys (0.57 mg kg −1 ww/month in groups 2-dep and 3-dep), in bones (0.72 mg kg −1 ww/month in group 3-dep), in scales (0.46 mg kg −1 ww/month in group 4-dep), and in hepatopancreas (0.33 mg kg −1 ww/month in groups 4-dep and 5-dep
statement: 在消除期前3个月，肾脏、骨骼、鳞片和肝胰腺中的铅浓度下降幅度最大。
text_zh: 在消除期前3个月，肾脏、骨骼、鳞片和肝胰腺中的铅浓度下降幅度最大。

quote: lead accumulation levels between groups were observed in all studied tissues (p 2c).
statement: 在所有研究的组织中观察到了组间铅积累水平的差异。
text_zh: 在所有研究的组织中观察到了组间铅积累水平的差异。
text_en: Differences in lead accumulation levels between groups were observed in all tissues studied.

quote: There were no significant differences in skin tissue.
statement: 皮肤组织中没有观察到显著差异。
text_zh: 皮肤组织中没有观察到显著差异。
text_en: No significant differences were observed in skin tissue.

quote: The accumulation of lead was generally the highest at the beginning of exposure, as evidenced by the highest monthly increments of bioaccumulation observed after 3 months of contamination for muscles, hepatopancreatic gland, intestine, and gills
statement: 铅的积累通常在暴露开始时最高，肌肉、肝胰腺、肠道和鳃在污染3个月后观察到最高的月度生物积累增量证明了这一点。
text_zh: 铅的积累通常在暴露开始时最高，肌肉、肝胰腺、肠道和鳃在污染3个月后观察到最高的月度生物积累增量证明了这一点。
text_en: Lead accumulation is usually highest at the beginning of exposure, as evidenced by the highest monthly bioaccumulation increments observed in muscle, hepatopancreas, intestine and gills after 3 months of contamination.
outcome: 特定组织的铅生物积累动态

quote: A decrease in the level of this metal to the values comparable with control values was observed in muscle tissue between 12 and 15 months of exposure
statement: 在暴露的第12至15个月期间，观察到肌肉组织中该金属水平下降至与对照组相当的值。
text_zh: 在暴露的第12至15个月期间，观察到肌肉组织中该金属水平下降至与对照组相当的值。
text_en: During months 12 to 15 of exposure, metal levels in muscle tissue were observed to decrease to values comparable to those of the control group.

quote: The widespread use of plant protein sources in recent years often leads to deficiencies in essential amino acids, especially methionine (Met) and lysine (Lys)
statement: 近年来植物蛋白源的广泛使用往往导致必需氨基酸缺乏，特别是蛋氨酸和赖氨酸。
text_zh: 近年来植物蛋白源的广泛使用往往导致必需氨基酸缺乏，特别是蛋氨酸和赖氨酸。
text_en: In recent years, the widespread use of plant protein sources often leads to a deficiency in essential amino acids, particularly methionine and lysine.

quote: For the intestine, higher lead concentrations were observed in the posterior part, where the highest mean concentration of 1.1 (±0.09) mg kg −1 occurred after 15 months of exposure to 49 mg Pb kg −1 in group 5 (Fig. 2b); whereas in the anterior part of the digestive tract, the highest mean concentration was 0.7 (±0.09) mg kg −1 (Fig. 2a).
statement: 肠道后部的铅浓度高于前部，在第5组暴露于49 mg Pb kg−1 15个月后，后部平均浓度最高为1.1 mg kg−1，而消化道前部最高平均浓度为0.7 mg kg−1。
text_zh: 肠道后部的铅浓度高于前部，在第5组暴露于49 mg Pb kg−1 15个月后，后部平均浓度最高为1.1 mg kg−1，而消化道前部最高平均浓度为0.7 mg kg−1。
text_en: Lead concentrations in the posterior intestine were higher than in the anterior part. After 15 months of exposure to 49 mg Pb kg−1 in Group 5, the highest mean concentration in the posterior part was 1.1 mg kg−1, while the highest mean concentration in the anterior digestive tract was 0.7 mg kg−1.

quote: Analysis of lead concentrations in pellet samples showed the following mean levels: group 1 control, 0.113 (±0.03) mg kg −1 ; group 2, 8.07 (±0.11) mg kg −1 ; group 3, 13.11 (±0.14) mg kg −1 ; group 4, 23.71 (±0.18) mg kg −1 ; and group 5, 48.62 (±0.24) mg kg −1 dw.
statement: 对颗粒饲料样品中铅浓度的分析显示各组平均水平分别为：对照组0.113 mg/kg，第2组8.07 mg/kg，第3组13.11 mg/kg，第4组23.71 mg/kg，第5组48.62 mg/kg（干重）。
text_zh: 对颗粒饲料样品中铅浓度的分析显示各组平均水平分别为：对照组0.113 mg/kg，第2组8.07 mg/kg，第3组13.11 mg/kg，第4组23.71 mg/kg，第5组48.62 mg/kg（干重）。
text_en: Analysis of lead concentrations in pellet feed samples showed average levels for each group as follows: control group 0.113 mg/kg, Group 2 8.07 mg/kg, Group 3 13.11 mg/kg, Group 4 23.71 mg/kg, and Group 5 48.62 mg/kg (dry weight).

quote: Number of fish at the beginning [ n ] (per aquarium) 30/30 30/30/30 30/30/30 30/30/30 30/30/30 420
statement: 实验开始时每个水族箱的鱼数量为30条，总鱼数为420条。
text_zh: 实验开始时每个水族箱的鱼数量为30条，总鱼数为420条。
text_en: At the start of the experiment, there were 30 fish per aquarium, with a total of 420 fish.

statement: 3个月后存活鱼数量减少至总计380条。
text_zh: 3个月后存活鱼数量减少至总计380条。
text_en: After 3 months, the number of surviving fish decreased to a total of 380.

statement: 6个月后存活鱼数量进一步减少至总计335条。
text_zh: 6个月后存活鱼数量进一步减少至总计335条。
text_en: After 6 months, the number of surviving fish further decreased to a total of 335.

statement: 12个月暴露期结束后，存活鱼数量总计为257条。
text_zh: 12个月暴露期结束后，存活鱼数量总计为257条。
text_en: At the end of the 12-month exposure period, the total number of surviving fish was 257.

quote: Pb level in the kidney of control fish significantly increased after 12 months of experiment and did not decreased to the end, despite the fish remained in the same conditions as the acclimation period.
statement: 在对照鱼中，肾脏中的铅水平在实验12个月后显著增加，并且直到结束都没有下降，尽管鱼保持在驯化期的相同条件下。
text_zh: 在对照鱼中，肾脏中的铅水平在实验12个月后显著增加，并且直到结束都没有下降，尽管鱼保持在驯化期的相同条件下。
text_en: In control fish, lead levels in the kidney increased significantly after 12 months of the experiment and did not decrease until the end, although the fish were kept under the same conditions as during the acclimation period.

quote: There was observed not significant decrease of Pb concentration in distal intestine and bone tissues of control fish, that would be accumulated in the kidney, but more likely the enhanced Pb level in the kidney was the effect of slow accumulation of Pb little rates 0.003 mg Pb kg −1 ww (body weight)/day, from control pellets which Pb concentration was 0.113 mg kg −1 dw.
statement: 观察到对照鱼远端肠道和骨组织中的铅浓度没有显著降低，这些本应积累在肾脏中，但更可能的是，肾脏中升高的铅水平是由于从铅浓度为0.113 mg kg−1干重的对照颗粒饲料中以每天0.003 mg Pb kg−1湿重（体重）的低速率缓慢积累铅的结果。
text_zh: 观察到对照鱼远端肠道和骨组织中的铅浓度没有显著降低，这些本应积累在肾脏中，但更可能的是，肾脏中升高的铅水平是由于从铅浓度为0.113 mg kg−1干重的对照颗粒饲料中以每天0.003 mg Pb kg−1湿重（体重）的低速率缓慢积累铅的结果。
text_en: No significant reduction in lead concentrations was observed in the distal intestine and bone tissue of control fish, which should have accumulated in the kidneys; rather, it is more likely that the elevated lead levels in the kidneys were the result of slow accumulation of lead at a low rate of 0.003 mg Pb kg−1 wet weight (body weight) per day from the control pelleted feed with a lead concentration of 0.113 mg kg−1 dry weight.

quote: In all tissues, the highest accumulation resulted from exposure to the highest dietary dose of lead, as confirmed by high correlation coefficients (from 0.61 to 0.96) for Pb concentration and dose in successive periods of the study (ESM Table 1S).
statement: 在所有组织中，最高的积累量源于暴露于最高剂量的膳食铅，这由研究连续期间铅浓度与剂量之间的高相关系数（0.61至0.96）所证实。
text_zh: 在所有组织中，最高的积累量源于暴露于最高剂量的膳食铅，这由研究连续期间铅浓度与剂量之间的高相关系数（0.61至0.96）所证实。
text_en: In all tissues, the highest accumulation resulted from exposure to the highest dose of dietary lead, as confirmed by the high correlation coefficients (0.61 to 0.96) between lead concentration and dose during the study period.

quote: While the added amino acids did not change growth rates, they significantly improved internal health by reducing blood fat levels and enhancing natural antioxidant defenses.
statement: 添加的氨基酸未改变生长率，但通过降低血脂水平和增强天然抗氧化防御显著改善了内部健康。
text_zh: 添加的氨基酸未改变生长率，但通过降低血脂水平和增强天然抗氧化防御显著改善了内部健康。
text_en: The added amino acids did not change the growth rate, but significantly improved internal health by lowering blood lipid levels and enhancing natural antioxidant defenses.
outcome: 血液生化指标与抗氧化能力

quote: Crespo et al. (1986) showed that rainbow trout orally administrated with Pb ((10 μg Pb/g dw)/fish/day) had morphological alternations of the intestinal brush border, increased mucous cell activity, an increased renewal rate of absorptive cells.
statement: 口服给予铅（每鱼每天10微克/干重）导致虹鳟肠刷状缘形态改变、黏液细胞活性增加以及吸收细胞更新率加快。
text_zh: 口服给予铅（每鱼每天10微克/干重）导致虹鳟肠刷状缘形态改变、黏液细胞活性增加以及吸收细胞更新率加快。
text_en: Oral administration of lead (10 micrograms per fish per day, dry weight) caused morphological changes in the intestinal brush border, increased mucous cell activity, and accelerated absorptive cell turnover in rainbow trout.
outcome: 肠道组织损伤与生理反应

quote: The hepatopancreas accumulates relatively higher amounts of Pb exceeding 4 mg kg −1 body weight during the exposure to 24 and 49 mg Pb kg −1 (Fig. 1c).
statement: 在暴露于24和49毫克铅/千克饲料期间，肝胰腺积累了相对较高的铅量，超过4毫克/千克体重。
text_zh: 在暴露于24和49毫克铅/千克饲料期间，肝胰腺积累了相对较高的铅量，超过4毫克/千克体重。
text_en: During exposure to 24 and 49 mg lead/kg feed, the hepatopancreas accumulated relatively high amounts of lead, exceeding 4 mg/kg body weight.
outcome: 肝胰腺重金属生物积累

quote: After 12 months of exposure to 13 mg Pb kg −1 , the maximal Pb concentration 2.2 mg kg −1 was noted in the tissue and significant decrease after 18 months.
statement: 在暴露于13 mg Pb kg−1 12个月后，组织中记录到最大铅浓度2.2 mg kg−1，并在18个月后出现显著下降。
text_zh: 在暴露于13 mg Pb kg−1 12个月后，组织中记录到最大铅浓度2.2 mg kg−1，并在18个月后出现显著下降。
text_en: After exposure to 13 mg Pb kg−1 for 12 months, a maximum lead concentration of 2.2 mg kg−1 was recorded in tissues, and a significant decrease occurred after 18 months.
outcome: 特定剂量下的铅排泄/调节

quote: During the exposure to higher Pb doses of 24 and 49 mg kg −1 , maximal observed Pb concentrations were 2.9 and 3.7 mg kg −1 , respectively, and no significant decreases during the rest of exposure were noted (Fig. 2e).
statement: 在暴露于较高铅剂量（24和49 mg kg−1）期间，观察到的最大铅浓度分别为2.9和3.7 mg kg−1，且在其余暴露期间未注意到显著下降。
text_zh: 在暴露于较高铅剂量（24和49 mg kg−1）期间，观察到的最大铅浓度分别为2.9和3.7 mg kg−1，且在其余暴露期间未注意到显著下降。
text_en: During exposure to higher lead doses (24 and 49 mg kg−1), the maximum observed lead concentrations were 2.9 and 3.7 mg kg−1, respectively, and no significant decrease was noted during the remaining exposure periods.
outcome: 高剂量下缺乏有效调节或排泄

quote: Alves and Wood (2006) noted related Pb accumulation effect during 42 days dietary Pb exposure of juvenile rainbow trout, suggesting that some tissues are able to adjust, regulate, and redistribute Pb to other tissues for detoxification or excretion of Pb.
statement: Alves和Wood (2006)指出，在幼年虹鳟鱼42天的膳食铅暴露期间存在相关的铅积累效应，这表明某些组织能够调整、调节并将铅重新分布到其他组织以进行解毒或排泄。
text_zh: Alves和Wood (2006)指出，在幼年虹鳟鱼42天的膳食铅暴露期间存在相关的铅积累效应，这表明某些组织能够调整、调节并将铅重新分布到其他组织以进行解毒或排泄。
text_en: Alves and Wood (2006) noted that there was a related lead accumulation effect during the 42-day dietary lead exposure of juvenile rainbow trout, indicating that certain tissues can adjust, regulate, and redistribute lead to other tissues for detoxification or excretion.
outcome: 组织间铅再分布与解毒机制

quote: After 24 h of fasting, all experimental fish were anesthetized via immersion in MS-222 (60 mg/L; E10521 , Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) prior to dissection.
statement: 禁食24小时后，所有实验鱼在解剖前通过浸泡MS-222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 禁食24小时后，所有实验鱼在解剖前通过浸泡MS-222进行麻醉。
text_en: After 24 hours of fasting, all experimental fish were anesthetized by immersion in MS-222 before dissection.

quote: Blood samples were drawn from the caudal vein and kept at 4 °C overnight, followed by centrifugation at 4500 rpm for 10 min.
statement: 血液样本从尾静脉抽取，并在4°C过夜保存后离心分离血清。
text_zh: 血液样本从尾静脉抽取，并在4°C过夜保存后离心分离血清。
text_en: Blood samples were drawn from the tail vein and centrifuged to separate serum after overnight storage at 4°C.

quote: Serum malondialdehyde (MDA), total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) were analyzed using their corresponding kits
statement: 血清丙二醛（MDA）、总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）使用相应的试剂盒进行分析。
text_zh: 血清丙二醛（MDA）、总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）使用相应的试剂盒进行分析。
text_en: Serum malondialdehyde (MDA), total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), and superoxide dismutase (SOD) were analyzed using corresponding kits.

quote: To avoid the dissolution of Pb from feces and pellets remains, aquarium water was changed every 2 weeks.
statement: 为避免粪便和颗粒残留物中铅的溶解，水族箱水每两周更换一次。
text_zh: 为避免粪便和颗粒残留物中铅的溶解，水族箱水每两周更换一次。
text_en: To avoid the dissolution of lead in feces and particulate residues, aquarium water is changed every two weeks.

quote: Water analysis indicated no detectable Pb level (detection limit, 0.001 mg Pb L −1) after 2 weeks of feeding fish with the contaminated pellets, despite the Pb concentrations in bottom sediments in aquariums were enhanced, from 1.5 (in control group) to 78 mg Pb kg −1 dw (in group 5).
statement: 尽管水族箱底部沉积物中的铅浓度从对照组的1.5增加到第5组的78 mg Pb kg−1 dw，但在用受污染颗粒喂养鱼2周后，水分析显示未检测到铅水平（检测限为0.001 mg Pb L−1）。
text_zh: 尽管水族箱底部沉积物中的铅浓度从对照组的1.5增加到第5组的78 mg Pb kg−1 dw，但在用受污染颗粒喂养鱼2周后，水分析显示未检测到铅水平（检测限为0.001 mg Pb L−1）。
text_en: Although lead concentrations in aquarium bottom sediments increased from 1.5 to 78 mg Pb kg−1 dw from the control group to Group 5, water analysis showed no detectable lead levels (detection limit of 0.001 mg Pb L−1) after feeding fish with contaminated particles for 2 weeks.

quote: The results obtained suggest that lead bioaccumulation in females of Prussian carp differs in dependence on tissues.
statement: 所得结果表明，雌性普鲁士鲤鱼的铅生物蓄积因组织而异。
text_zh: 所得结果表明，雌性普鲁士鲤鱼的铅生物蓄积因组织而异。
text_en: The results showed that lead bioaccumulation in female Prussian carp varied by tissue.

quote: Daily intake of lead ranged from 0.24 to 1.47 mg kg −1 ww (body weight)/day depending on the dose of exposure, so the fish received a total dose of 108–540 and 216–1,080 mg Pb kg −1 body weight after 12 and 24 months of exposure, respectively.
statement: 每日铅摄入量范围为0.24至1.47 mg kg−1 ww（体重）/天，取决于暴露剂量，因此鱼在暴露12个月和24个月后分别接受了108–540和216–1,080 mg Pb kg−1体重的总剂量。
text_zh: 每日铅摄入量范围为0.24至1.47 mg kg−1 ww（体重）/天，取决于暴露剂量，因此鱼在暴露12个月和24个月后分别接受了108–540和216–1,080 mg Pb kg−1体重的总剂量。

quote: no mortality occurred during the 8-week trial (Survival rate = 100%)
statement: 在为期8周的试验期间没有发生死亡，存活率为100%。
text_zh: 在为期8周的试验期间没有发生死亡，存活率为100%。
text_en: No deaths occurred during the 8-week trial period, and the survival rate was 100%.

quote: While the highest monthly increments of lead are observed after 12 months of exposure in group 2 (0.09(± 0.001) mg Pb kg −1 ww/month) and after 6 months in groups 3 and 4 (0.28 (± 0.008) mg Pb kg −1 ww/month), in group 5 they already reach a mean value of 0.44 (± 0.02) mg kg −1 ww/month after 3 months (ESM Fig. 1S).
statement: 在暴露剂量较高的组别中，骨骼组织中的铅积累速度更快。
text_zh: 在暴露剂量较高的组别中，骨骼组织中的铅积累速度更快。
text_en: In the groups with higher exposure doses, lead accumulation in skeletal tissue was faster.
outcome: 重金属在骨骼中的积累速率

quote: Exactly the same accumulation pattern was observed in scales, where very high coefficients of correlation between Pb concentration and exposure dose were noted (ESM Table 1S).
statement: 鳞片中也观察到了相同的积累模式，且铅浓度与暴露剂量之间存在极高的相关系数。
text_zh: 鳞片中也观察到了相同的积累模式，且铅浓度与暴露剂量之间存在极高的相关系数。
text_en: The same accumulation pattern was observed in the scales, and there was a very high correlation coefficient between lead concentration and exposure dose.
outcome: 重金属在鳞片中的积累

quote: Their deficiency can ultimately limit fish growth and reduce feed efficiency.
statement: 它们的缺乏最终会限制鱼类的生长并降低饲料效率。
text_zh: 它们的缺乏最终会限制鱼类的生长并降低饲料效率。
text_en: Their deficiency ultimately limits fish growth and reduces feed efficiency.

quote: Moreover, appropriate levels of dietary Lys can promote meat quality and development of fish muscle fibers, and it has irreplaceable functions in promoting lipid metabolism, enhancing immunity and antioxidant capacity, increasing muscle protein deposition, and regulating intestinal digestive enzyme activity
statement: 此外，适当水平的膳食赖氨酸可以促进肉质和鱼肌纤维的发育，并在促进脂质代谢、增强免疫力和抗氧化能力、增加肌肉蛋白质沉积以及调节肠道消化酶活性方面具有不可替代的功能。
text_zh: 此外，适当水平的膳食赖氨酸可以促进肉质和鱼肌纤维的发育，并在促进脂质代谢、增强免疫力和抗氧化能力、增加肌肉蛋白质沉积以及调节肠道消化酶活性方面具有不可替代的功能。
text_en: In addition, appropriate levels of dietary lysine can promote the development of meat quality and fish muscle fibers, and have irreplaceable functions in promoting lipid metabolism, enhancing immunity and antioxidant capacity, increasing muscle protein deposition, and regulating intestinal digestive enzyme activity.
outcome: 肉质/免疫力/抗氧化/脂质代谢/消化酶活性

quote: In the groups of fish exposed to lower doses of lead (8 and 13 mg kg −1 ; groups 2 and 3, respectively), the accumulation of this metal in the bone in the first year of exposure was twice as high as in the second year, and lead concentrations were indeed observed to decrease in groups 2 and 3, possibly indicating that partial self-depuration from the tissue could occur in the second year of exposure to lower Pb concentrations (8–13 mg Pb kg −1 dw), despite continued exposure (Fig. 2d).
statement: 在暴露于较低剂量铅（8和13 mg/kg）的鱼群中，第一年骨骼中的金属积累量是第二年的两倍，且观察到铅浓度下降，这可能表明尽管持续暴露，但在第二年低铅浓度下可能发生部分组织自我净化。
text_zh: 在暴露于较低剂量铅（8和13 mg/kg）的鱼群中，第一年骨骼中的金属积累量是第二年的两倍，且观察到铅浓度下降，这可能表明尽管持续暴露，但在第二年低铅浓度下可能发生部分组织自我净化。
text_en: In fish groups exposed to lower doses of lead (8 and 13 mg/kg), metal accumulation in the skeleton during the first year was twice that of the second year, and a decrease in lead concentration was observed, which may indicate partial tissue self-purification at low lead concentrations in the second year despite continuous exposure.
outcome: 骨骼铅蓄积动态/自我净化能力

quote: Also, analysis of the monthly increments of bioaccumulation in bone tissue (ESM Fig. 1S) and the highly significant coefficients of correlation (ESM Table 1S) indicate that the accumulation is clearly dependent on dose of exposure.
statement: 对骨组织中生物累积月度增量的分析以及高度显著的相关系数表明，累积明显依赖于暴露剂量。
text_zh: 对骨组织中生物累积月度增量的分析以及高度显著的相关系数表明，累积明显依赖于暴露剂量。
text_en: Analysis of the monthly increment in bioaccumulation in bone tissue and highly significant correlation coefficients indicate that accumulation clearly depends on exposure dose.

quote: Survival rate remained unaffected across all groups.
statement: 所有组的存活率均未受影响。
text_zh: 所有组的存活率均未受影响。
text_en: Survival rates were not affected in any group.

quote: Additionally, no significant changes were detected in the condition factor, viscerosomatic index, or hepatosomatic index of HCC among different treatment groups.
statement: 此外，不同处理组之间河方鲫的肥满度、脏体指数或肝体指数未检测到显著变化。
text_zh: 此外，不同处理组之间河方鲫的肥满度、脏体指数或肝体指数未检测到显著变化。
text_en: In addition, no significant changes were detected in the condition factor, viscerosomatic index, or hepatosomatic index of river crucian carp among different treatment groups.

quote: However, the GLU levels in the HA group was significantly increased when the supplemental level of Met was further increased.
statement: 然而，当进一步增加蛋氨酸的补充水平时，HA组的血糖水平显著升高。
text_zh: 然而，当进一步增加蛋氨酸的补充水平时，HA组的血糖水平显著升高。
text_en: However, when the methionine supplementation level was further increased, blood glucose levels in the HA group significantly increased.
outcome: 血糖水平/应激或代谢状态

quote: Prior to the formal culture experiment, all fish were acclimated in an indoor fiberglass tank (1500 L) for one week.
statement: 所有实验鱼在正式养殖试验前，在室内玻璃钢水箱中驯化一周。
text_zh: 所有实验鱼在正式养殖试验前，在室内玻璃钢水箱中驯化一周。
text_en: All experimental fish were acclimated for one week in indoor fiberglass water tanks before the formal culture trial.

quote: Subsequently, 135 apparently healthy Hefang crucian carp with an average body weight of (100.0 ± 2.5) g were randomly cultured in 9 fiberglass tanks (90 L), with three tanks serving as one replicate group (15 fish per tank).
statement: 随后将135条表观健康的和方鲫鱼随机放入9个玻璃钢水箱（90升）中养殖，每箱15条鱼。
text_zh: 随后将135条表观健康的和方鲫鱼随机放入9个玻璃钢水箱（90升）中养殖，每箱15条鱼。
text_en: Subsequently, 135 apparently healthy crucian carp were randomly placed into 9 fiberglass-reinforced plastic water tanks (90 liters) for rearing, with 15 fish per tank.

quote: The experimental conditions were: water temperature (25.5 ± 1.0) °C, dissolved oxygen levels around 6.5 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen concentration below 0.5 mg/kg, pH maintained between 6.5 and 7.0, and a 12 h light–dark cycle (light from 8:00 to 20:00).
statement: 实验条件包括水温、溶解氧、氨氮浓度、pH值和光照周期的特定范围。
text_zh: 实验条件包括水温、溶解氧、氨氮浓度、pH值和光照周期的特定范围。
text_en: The experimental conditions included specific ranges for water temperature, dissolved oxygen, ammonia nitrogen concentration, pH value, and photoperiod.

quote: Fish were fed two times daily at 8:00 and 16:00 until reaching obvious satiety, defined as cessation of active feeding and fish ignoring the offered feed (typically within 5–10 min).
statement: 鱼每天喂食两次，直至达到明显饱食状态，定义为停止主动摄食并忽略提供的饲料。
text_zh: 鱼每天喂食两次，直至达到明显饱食状态，定义为停止主动摄食并忽略提供的饲料。
text_en: Fish are fed twice daily until a visibly satiated state is reached, defined as ceasing active feeding and ignoring the provided feed.

quote: Throughout the experiment, one-fifth of the water was replaced daily to maintain water quality.
statement: 在整个实验期间，每天更换五分之一的水以维持水质。
text_zh: 在整个实验期间，每天更换五分之一的水以维持水质。
text_en: During the entire experimental period, one-fifth of the water was changed daily to maintain water quality.

quote: the activities of antioxidant enzymes, including total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC) and superoxide dismutase (SOD), were significantly elevated with increasing amino acid concentrations.
statement: 随着氨基酸浓度的增加，总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）等抗氧化酶的活性显著升高。
text_zh: 随着氨基酸浓度的增加，总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）等抗氧化酶的活性显著升高。
text_en: As amino acid concentration increased, the activity of antioxidant enzymes such as total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) significantly increased.
outcome: 血清及肌肉抗氧化能力

quote: In contrast, the malondialdehyde (MDA) content exhibited a reverse trend, with its lowest level observed in the MA group (Figure 1 C).
statement: 相反，丙二醛（MDA）含量呈现相反的趋势，在MA组中观察到最低水平。
text_zh: 相反，丙二醛（MDA）含量呈现相反的趋势，在MA组中观察到最低水平。
text_en: In contrast, malondialdehyde (MDA) content showed the opposite trend, with the lowest level observed in the MA group.

quote: the expression levels of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), glutathione peroxidase 1a (GPX1a), and glutathione s-transferase pi 1 (GSTP1) were significantly upregulated following supplementation with moderate concentrations of Met and Lys
statement: 补充中等浓度的蛋氨酸（Met）和赖氨酸（Lys）后，核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶1a（GPX1a）和谷胱甘肽S-转移酶pi 1（GSTP1）的表达水平显著上调。
text_zh: 补充中等浓度的蛋氨酸（Met）和赖氨酸（Lys）后，核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶1a（GPX1a）和谷胱甘肽S-转移酶pi 1（GSTP1）的表达水平显著上调。
text_en: Supplementation with moderate concentrations of methionine (Met) and lysine (Lys) significantly upregulated the expression levels of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), glutathione peroxidase 1a (GPX1a), and glutathione S-transferase pi 1 (GSTP1).
intervention_record: 中等水平蛋氨酸赖氨酸

quote: However, no significant improvement in growth performance was observed under the present experimental conditions,
statement: 然而，在目前的实验条件下，未观察到生长性能的显著改善。
text_zh: 然而，在目前的实验条件下，未观察到生长性能的显著改善。
text_en: However, no significant improvement in growth performance was observed under the current experimental conditions.

quote: This attenuation may be attributed to the oxidative stress and metabolic burden induced by excessive dietary Met, which impairs cellular antioxidant defense mechanisms.
statement: 过量的膳食蛋氨酸可能通过诱导氧化应激和代谢负担来损害细胞抗氧化防御机制。
text_zh: 过量的膳食蛋氨酸可能通过诱导氧化应激和代谢负担来损害细胞抗氧化防御机制。
text_en: Excess dietary methionine may impair cellular antioxidant defense mechanisms by inducing oxidative stress and metabolic burden.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化能力

quote: Consistent with our results, a previous study reported that an optimal Met level (0.84%) activated the Nrf2 pathway in juvenile blunt snout bream (Megalobrama amblycephala), whereas excessive Met supplementation (1.28%) failed to yield further antioxidant improvements [ 57 ].
statement: 先前的研究报告称，在幼体团头鲂中，最佳蛋氨酸水平（0.84%）激活了Nrf2通路，而过量蛋氨酸补充（1.28%）未能带来进一步的抗氧化改善。
text_zh: 先前的研究报告称，在幼体团头鲂中，最佳蛋氨酸水平（0.84%）激活了Nrf2通路，而过量蛋氨酸补充（1.28%）未能带来进一步的抗氧化改善。
text_en: Previous research reported that in juvenile Megalobrama amblycephala, the optimal methionine level (0.84%) activated the Nrf2 pathway, while excessive methionine supplementation (1.28%) did not bring further antioxidant improvement.

quote: This study demonstrated that Met and Lys diets could increase serum SOD and T-AOC, thereby enhancing the antioxidant capacity of HCC.
statement: 本研究表明，蛋氨酸和赖氨酸日粮可提高血清超氧化物歧化酶和总抗氧化能力，从而增强HCC的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 本研究表明，蛋氨酸和赖氨酸日粮可提高血清超氧化物歧化酶和总抗氧化能力，从而增强HCC的抗氧化能力。
text_en: This study shows that methionine and lysine diets can increase serum superoxide dismutase and total antioxidant capacity, thereby enhancing the antioxidant capacity of HCC.

quote: MDA, as a lipid oxidation product, directly reflects physiological oxidative stress [ 50 ], which can be induced by dietary Met deficiency in fish
statement: 丙二醛作为脂质氧化产物，直接反映生理性氧化应激，这在鱼类中可由膳食蛋氨酸缺乏诱导。
text_zh: 丙二醛作为脂质氧化产物，直接反映生理性氧化应激，这在鱼类中可由膳食蛋氨酸缺乏诱导。
text_en: Malondialdehyde, as a lipid oxidation product, directly reflects physiological oxidative stress, which can be induced by dietary methionine deficiency in fish.

quote: The supplementation of Met and Lys at a moderate level (MA group) significantly reduced serum MDA content, suggesting a potential inhibitory effect on lipid peroxidation and oxidative damage in HCC.
statement: 中等水平的蛋氨酸和赖氨酸补充（MA组）显著降低了血清丙二醛含量，表明其对HCC中的脂质过氧化和氧化损伤具有潜在的抑制作用。
text_zh: 中等水平的蛋氨酸和赖氨酸补充（MA组）显著降低了血清丙二醛含量，表明其对HCC中的脂质过氧化和氧化损伤具有潜在的抑制作用。
text_en: Moderate-level methionine and lysine supplementation (MA group) significantly reduced serum malondialdehyde content, indicating a potential inhibitory effect on lipid peroxidation and oxidative damage in HCC.
intervention_record: 中等水平蛋氨酸赖氨酸
outcome: 氧化损伤与脂质过氧化

quote: However, MDA levels increased again in the HA group, approximating those of the LA group. This dose-dependent response suggests that while moderate supplementation may enhance antioxidant capacity, excessive Met and Lys intake could attenuate these benefits.
statement: 然而，HA组的MDA水平再次升高，接近LA组。这种剂量依赖性反应表明，虽然适度补充可能增强抗氧化能力，但过量的蛋氨酸和赖氨酸摄入可能会减弱这些益处。
